The supplied structure is a single-atom krypton crystal described in a rhombohedral-like primitive input cell whose three lattice vectors are all 4.34152911 Å long and whose three interaxial angles are all 109.47122063°, the tetrahedral angle. The declared input composition contains one Kr atom per input cell, and the input cell contains exactly one atom. The symmetry assigned to the structure is space group No. 229, Im-3m, with Hall symbol "-I 4 2 3".

The coordinate description uses fractional coordinates, and the standard crystallographic frame is related to the supplied input frame by q_standard = P q_input + s. The transformation matrix P has rows (0.5, -0.5, 0.5), (-0.5, 0.5, 0.5), and (-0.5, -0.5000000000000001, 0.5), while the origin shift s is (0, 0, 0). Thus the input and standard origins coincide, and the nearly -0.5 value in the third row is the only deviation from an exactly half-integral transformation entry. This relation allows the original input cell to be recovered from the standard setting.

In the standard Im-3m description, the single independent krypton orbit is the Wyckoff orbit 2a, represented by an atom at fractional coordinate (0, 0, 0) with the fixed coordinate relation "0, 0, 0". It has no independent positional parameters. Its multiplicity is two in the body-centered conventional cell, corresponding to the two translation-related positions generated by the I-centering operation. Because the representative lies at the origin, the second conventional-cell position is the body-centered equivalent at (1/2, 1/2, 1/2), while the supplied primitive input cell contains only the one Kr atom at the origin.

The positional values were rounded to zero digits before any correction step, and no precision corrections are listed. Consequently, the geometry is exactly the stated one: one krypton sublattice on the 2a sites of Im-3m, with the primitive input cell defined by three equal 4.34152911 Å vectors meeting at 109.47122063°, and with the standard body-centered description obtained through the specified linear frame transformation.
